event.name: Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 @ UTM
event.globalTheme: A Decade of Quantum on the Cloud
event.themeContext: Ten years since the first open-access quantum computer became available on the cloud.
event.organizer: Student-led committee at Universiti Teknologi Malaysia
event.collaboration: In collaboration with IBM Quantum, the Faculty of Computing, and the Faculty of Science.
event.selectionHighlight: UTM is one of only three Malaysian universities selected for IBM sponsorship in the 2026 cycle. More than 900 universities applied worldwide and 200 were selected.
event.outcome: Launch the UTM Quantum student community, build a path to MyQI affiliation, and create annual continuity for student-led quantum learning.

faq.answer: No. The day is designed for beginners from computing, science, and other fields. Curiosity and a willingness to try are enough.
